text:
## Third-Party Risk  
### Vendor Security Assessment  
**Pre-Assessment:**
- Security questionnaire completed
- SOC 2 Type II audit reviewed (if available)
- Penetration test results (if applicable)
- Reference checks (other customers)  
**Ongoing:**
- Annual re-assessment
- Incident notification requirements (SLA: 24 hours)
- Audit rights (FirstUK Bank can audit vendor)
- Service Level Agreement (SLA) for security
name: Chunk 19/32

raw_entities.name: Third-Party Risk Management Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the security assessment and ongoing monitoring of third-party vendors and service providers. Establishes pre-assessment requirements including security questionnaires, SOC 2 Type II audits, and penetration testing, along with continuous oversight mechanisms including annual re-assessments and incident notification protocols.

raw_entities.name: Security Questionnaire Completion
raw_entities.description: Vendors must complete a security questionnaire as part of the pre-assessment phase before engagement.

raw_entities.name: SOC 2 Type II Audit Review
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank must review SOC 2 Type II audit results from vendors when available as part of pre-assessment security evaluation.
context: SOC 2 Type II audit reviewed (if available)

raw_entities.name: Penetration Test Results Review
raw_entities.description: Penetration test results must be reviewed during pre-assessment when applicable to the vendor's service scope.

raw_entities.name: Vendor Reference Checks
raw_entities.description: Reference checks with other customers of the vendor must be conducted as part of the pre-assessment phase.

raw_entities.name: Annual Vendor Re-Assessment
raw_entities.description: Vendors must undergo annual re-assessment to ensure continued compliance with security standards and policy requirements.

raw_entities.name: Incident Notification Requirement
raw_entities.description: Vendors are required to notify FirstUK Bank of security incidents within 24 hours as defined by the Service Level Agreement.

raw_entities.name: Bank Audit Rights Over Vendor
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank retains the right to audit vendors to verify compliance with security and operational standards.
context: Audit rights (FirstUK Bank can audit vendor)

raw_entities.name: Service Level Agreement for Security
raw_entities.description: A Service Level Agreement must be established with vendors defining security performance standards and incident response obligations.

raw_entities.name: Security Questionnaire
raw_entities.description: Assessment tool used to gather security information from vendors during the pre-engagement phase.

raw_entities.name: SOC 2 Type II Audit Review
raw_entities.description: Review of SOC 2 Type II audit reports to verify vendor compliance with security and operational controls.
context: SOC 2 Type II audit reviewed (if available)

raw_entities.name: Penetration Testing
raw_entities.description: Security testing conducted by or for vendors to identify vulnerabilities in systems and infrastructure.

raw_entities.name: Vendor Reference Checks
raw_entities.description: Due diligence process involving consultation with other customers to assess vendor reliability and security practices.

raw_entities.name: Annual Vendor Security Re-Assessment
raw_entities.description: Periodic review and re-evaluation of vendor security posture and compliance status on an annual basis.

raw_entities.name: Incident Notification Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Monitoring mechanism to track vendor incident notifications and ensure compliance with the 24-hour SLA requirement.

raw_entities.name: Vendor Audit Program
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's audit function to verify vendor compliance with contractual security obligations and policy requirements.
context: Audit rights (FirstUK Bank can audit vendor)

raw_entities.name: Third-Party Security Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk arising from security vulnerabilities, inadequate controls, or non-compliance by third-party vendors and service providers that could impact FirstUK Bank's operations, data, or reputation.

raw_entities.name: Vendor Incident Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk of security incidents occurring at vendor facilities or systems that could affect FirstUK Bank's services or customer data.

raw_entities.name: Third-Party Risk Manager
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for overseeing vendor security assessments, conducting pre-assessments, managing ongoing monitoring, and exercising audit rights over third-party vendors.
context: Audit rights (FirstUK Bank can audit vendor)

properties.scope_summary: Applies to all vendors and third-party service providers; covers pre-assessment security evaluation and ongoing monitoring
properties.core_policy_statement: FirstUK Bank requires comprehensive security assessment of third-party vendors prior to engagement and maintains ongoing monitoring and audit rights

properties.risk_definition: Risk that a third-party vendor lacks adequate security controls or fails to maintain security standards
Risk that a third-party vendor experiences a security incident that impacts FirstUK Bank
properties.required_response: Vendor must notify bank within 24 hours; bank investigates and responds

specific_obligation: Review SOC 2 Type II audits when available
Review penetration test results when applicable
